name: Grist
short_desc: Grist spreadsheet-database with the built-in MCP server enabled
author: Grist Labs
description: Grist is a modern relational spreadsheet: the flexibility of a spreadsheet with the robustness of a database. This build exposes the environment variables the official Runtipi app hides, so the built-in MCP server and Grist's OAuth/OIDC server can be switched on and AI assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT can read and edit documents at https://<your-grist-host>/api/mcp.

form_fields.label: Sandbox flavor
form_fields.hint: Sandbox used to run formula code. gvisor is the safe default; use unsandboxed only on hardware where gvisor fails.

form_fields.label: Enable MCP server
form_fields.hint: Serves the built-in Model Context Protocol endpoint at /api/mcp. Requires the full edition to be activated in the Admin Panel.

form_fields.label: Enable OAuth / OIDC server
form_fields.hint: Issues the tokens MCP clients and OAuth apps sign in with. Needed for interactive sign-in from Claude and ChatGPT.

form_fields.label: CIMD allowed hosts
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated hosts allowed to register themselves via a Client ID Metadata Document. Empty disables CIMD. Avoid '*'.

form_fields.label: Enable Dynamic Client Registration
form_fields.hint: Serves POST /oidc/reg so clients that do not support CIMD can register themselves. Leave off unless a client needs it.

form_fields.label: DCR rate limit (requests/minute)
form_fields.hint: Only relevant when Dynamic Client Registration is enabled.

form_fields.label: Session secret
form_fields.hint: Keeps login sessions valid across container recreates. Generated once — back it up with your app data.

form_fields.label: Default email (single-user mode)
form_fields.hint: Optional. If set, anonymous visitors are logged in as this user. Leave empty when you want real sign-in — MCP clients authenticate as a real account.

form_fields.label: Force login
form_fields.hint: Blocks all anonymous access, including publicly shared documents.

form_fields.label: Activation key (full edition)
form_fields.hint: Optional. Paste a full-edition activation key here instead of entering it in the Admin Panel. MCP and the OIDC server are full-edition features.
